From your window to your notch

An illustrative demo: press left Shift and right Shift together to capture an app. Its screenshot becomes a card, then moves into the notch shelf. Copy the screenshot and accessibility tree together, or choose just one in Settings.

A little heads-up. This is an early development build and isn’t notarized by Apple yet, so macOS may block it from opening. Capture needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions. What’s captured and pasted can vary by app.
